lines: Episode 405 (2026-10-20). The host opens three shows before her maternity leave with the Brian Cole Jr. case. She says independent journalist Steve Baker and his team found CCTV footage from January 5, 2021 that, in her account, shows the real Brian Cole Jr. across town at 7:57 p.m. while the pipe-bomb suspect was on camera elsewhere. She plays clips about his shoes, a jacket still carrying a tag and a handmade Washington Football Team mask, and reads Baker's X post saying Cole's grandmother bought the jacket on her Kohl's card. She ties Scripps Media's release of old bodycam footage of both Cole and Tyler Robinson to the CIA's Operation Mockingbird, saying Carl Bernstein named Scripps among cooperating outlets.

The core segment is what the host calls exclusive UVU footage from September 10. She recalls Officer Bagley's preliminary-hearing testimony that he did not review video for anyone on the Losee rooftop between the jump at 12:23 p.m. and his arrival at 12:44 p.m. She then shows footage of a very tall figure she nicknames "Slenderman", who she believes is the same person who jumped off the roof. According to the host, he returns to the ledge around 12:36, lingers, goes back to the ledge at 12:40 when the footage blacks out for about a minute, and leaves at 12:42, less than a minute before Bagley arrives and finds the screwdriver. The host states as her opinion, not as fact, that the missing minute may show a screwdriver being dropped, and that Robinson did not shoot Charlie Kirk from the Losee rooftop.

The host also releases two more show trading cards (General McCoy and an FBI card). She answers Jeremy Boreing's X exchange with a viewer by reading from her Daily Wire firing document, which she says cites her tweet that no government has a right to commit genocide. She discusses Kimberly Guilfoyle's resignation as ambassador to Greece, including a report that she asked Eric Deters for $100,000 to pay off her credit card, and says she is "team Kimberly" given what she calls wider Trump-family corruption. Viewer comments cover Tyler Bowyer, Latvian bot farms, lawfare and the risk of executing an innocent Tyler Robinson.

lines: - MISTRANSCRIPTION: "Brian Cole Jr." -> "Brian J. Cole Jr." (00:02:24) source: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ihLQRXxIfjU&t=144 (N-25). Also "Brian Cole's" / "Brian Cole's grandmother" -> "Brian Cole('s)" (00:06:19, 00:07:59).
- MISTRANSCRIPTION: "operation Mockingbird" -> "Operation Mockingbird" (00:04:26); "American psy" is likely "American patsy" (00:04:26). Not changed in snippets.
- MISTRANSCRIPTION: "Director Kash" -> "Director Kash [Patel]" (00:08:31, inside Baker's post) (N-69).

- MISTRANSCRIPTION: "Kimberly Guilfoyle" / "Kimberly Guilfoyle" / "Kimberly Guilfoyle" / "Kimberly Guilfoyle" -> "Kimberly Guilfoyle" (00:38:23, 00:38:54, 00:40:28, 00:41:03, 00:41:39) source: https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/10/13/trumps-ambassador-to-greece-asked-to-resign-amid-misconduct-allegations

- MISTRANSCRIPTION: "Eric Deters" -> "Eric Deters" (00:39:24) source: https://gvwire.com/2026/10/13/kimberly-guilfoyle-resigns-as-ambassador-to-greece/ (news reports say Deters told The Wall Street Journal that Guilfoyle asked him for $100,000 for her American Express bill; the host's wording "came out to Eric Deters" reads as if Deters were the reporter, but he is the donor.)
- MISTRANSCRIPTION: "Tucker Carlson" -> "Tucker Carlson" (00:45:22) (Tucker Carlson; not cited in a claim).
- MISTRANSCRIPTION: "Togepi Pokemon" -> "Togepi Pokémon" (00:31:42); "hokey Pokemon" / "Hokemon" is the show's own name for its cards.

- UNRESOLVED: "FBI now" (00:31:11), the name on the second trading card. The stats ("See you in Valhalla. Rest now, brother", chugging beer in a locker room, country music) fit FBI Director Kash Patel, but the name is not audible in the transcript, so no person is cited on C-14528.

- UNRESOLVED: the speakers in the Brian Cole Jr. clips (00:07:27–00:08:31 and 00:09:05–00:11:18) are not named on air. The first speaker says he found the jacket in Cole's room. The second refers to "Brian Senior" in the third person. Both are recorded as unnamed clip speakers. A web search did not identify them.

- UNRESOLVED: "Kell Kelly Fuller" (00:33:54) is a private X user, and "Loretta" (00:08:31) is Cole's grandmother, named by first name only. No nodes minted. Viewers Stacy, Meaning heels, New/Sarah Aziz, Kiwi Kell/Kelly, Ali, Brooke, Earl's daughter, Tony Hill and Blushing Chaos are private commenters. No nodes minted.
- Host error: "the feds were responsible for February 6th" (00:03:09). She means January 6. The claim notes it.

- Host inconsistency: at 00:17:40 the host says Slenderman is the person who "jumped off the Losee rooftop at 12:35 p.m.", but elsewhere she gives the jump as 12:23 p.m. and says the 00:18:15 footage is "12 minutes after Charlie is hit" (about 12:35). The 12:35 appears to be the time of the footage, not of the jump. Recorded as said.
- Factual note: the firing document as read says "October 7th, 2024". The Hamas attack was on October 7, 2023. Kept verbatim in the artifact quote.
- Factual note: C-14541. The host credits Axios. Other outlets report the $100,000 request as originally reported by The Wall Street Journal.
- Opinion flagged: C-14523, C-14524 and C-14525 are labelled by the host as her opinion or speculation ("this is not a fact. It's an opinion"). They are recorded as attributed opinion.

- Not a DIA beat: "one of you guys sent me over a tip" (00:04:26) is a viewer tip about Oswald and Mockingbird history, not a tip on the case. None of the listed keywords appear. The candaceowens.com merch plug (00:51:15) is merch, not a tip request. No M-12 occurrence.
- Artifact referenced but not shown: A-3431.1 (Axios report, verbal only).
- Ads skipped (Pre-born, Balance of Nature, Wild Pastures, Battalion Metals, American Financing). The ad copy on the Strait of Hormuz and the war in Iran is not a claim.

- Rejected claims (admission test): the Nick Shirley favela quip (00:00:33); "feds might even be intentionally targeting autistic" people (00:01:04, speculation); "This feels like the DoD is putting people on payroll" (00:05:00, framing); Bagley "pretending he doesn't really comprehend" and "a narrative that glows" (00:13:38, 00:14:44); the book club and Freud claim on The Assault on Truth (00:32:43, off-topic opinion); "I'm team Kimberly Guilfoyle" and "they should cut her in to the crypto scams" (00:40:28, 00:41:39, opinion); "He has betrayed everyone, including Charlie Kirk" (00:41:39, opinion); the Saudi Arabia conference aside (00:45:22); "that's what Charlie said no to" (00:48:05, opinion she labels as such); "Justice for Katie" and the Mariah Carey joke (00:49:39); the hot-dog-sandwich bit (00:51:48).
